name: Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana
certifications: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (useful for Kubernetes monitoring)

beginner.summary: For engineers, support staff and developers new to monitoring. Covers monitoring concepts, Prometheus architecture and configuration, exporters, metric types, PromQL, instrumenting applications, service discovery, Grafana data sources, dashboards and panels, templating, alerting rules, Alertmanager routing, recording rules, blackbox probes, database and container monitoring, Loki logs and dashboards as code.
prerequisites: Comfortable on the Linux command line
Understands what a web service and an HTTP status code are
outcomes: Write PromQL queries and build useful dashboards
Instrument applications and monitor hosts, databases and containers
Alert on real problems and route alerts to the right people

days.topic: Monitoring Overview and Prometheus and Grafana Setup
subtopics: Why monitor: availability, performance and capacity
Installing Prometheus, Grafana and node_exporter with Docker Compose
days.lab_task: Start Prometheus, Grafana and node_exporter with Docker Compose, confirm Prometheus scrapes node_exporter, query CPU use in the Prometheus UI and add Prometheus as a Grafana data source.
days.deliverable: Compose file, screenshots and a short description of each component

days.lab_task: Add scrape jobs for three targets, relabel targets with environment and team labels, change retention, check the file with promtool and reload without a restart.
days.deliverable: prometheus.yml and verification output
checks: Series carry environment and team labels

days.topic: Exporters and Host Monitoring with node_exporter
subtopics: CPU, memory, disk and network metrics
days.lab_task: Monitor two Linux hosts and one Windows host, turn on extra collectors, add a textfile metric for the last backup time and find the busiest disk.
days.deliverable: Exporter configuration and queries
checks: Disk with highest I/O time named

days.topic: Metric Types: Counters, Gauges, Histograms and Summaries
days.lab_task: Expose a counter, a gauge, a histogram and a summary from a small Python service, generate traffic and explain what each one tells you.
days.deliverable: Service code, metrics output and explanation
checks: Counter resets and rate() handles it

days.topic: Querying with PromQL: Selectors, Rates and Aggregation
days.lab_task: Write queries for request rate per service, error percentage, CPU use per host, top five memory users and disk space left, and fix three broken queries.
days.deliverable: Query library with results
checks: Find the top five memory users
Each fixed with the reason noted

subtopics: RED metrics: rate, errors and duration
Labels for endpoints and status codes
days.lab_task: Instrument a web API with request counts, errors and durations per endpoint, add a business metric for orders placed and avoid putting user IDs in labels.
days.deliverable: Instrumented code and example queries
checks: No user IDs or other unbounded labels

subtopics: Why static targets do not scale
tools: AWS EC2 or a simulated file source
days.lab_task: Replace static targets with file-based discovery, add EC2 discovery that keeps only instances tagged for monitoring, and relabel instance names from tags.
days.deliverable: Discovery configuration and targets page screenshots
checks: Add a host to the discovery file

subtopics: Prometheus, Loki and other data sources
days.lab_task: Add Prometheus and Loki data sources, investigate a spike in Explore by comparing metrics and logs side by side and use the query inspector to see the query sent.
days.deliverable: Data source settings and an investigation note
checks: Metrics and logs shown for the same time
Cause found from metrics and logs

subtopics: Choosing what goes on a dashboard
days.lab_task: Build a service dashboard with request rate, errors, latency and saturation at the top, host details below, deployment annotations and links to a host dashboard.
days.deliverable: Dashboard JSON and screenshot
checks: Key signals visible at the top
Opens the host dashboard with the same time range

days.lab_task: Show the same latency data as a time series, a heatmap and percentile lines, build a table of hosts with transformations and replace two misleading gauges.
days.deliverable: Panels and a note on choices
checks: Hosts with key values in columns

days.lab_task: Template the service dashboard with environment, service and instance filters that depend on each other, repeat a panel per instance and pass filters in links.
days.deliverable: Templated dashboard and screenshots
checks: Service list shows only services in it
Filters carried to the next dashboard

subtopics: Alerting on symptoms rather than causes
days.lab_task: Write alerts for a down target, high error rate, high latency and disk filling within four hours, test them with promtool unit tests and trigger each one.
days.deliverable: Rule files, tests and alert screenshots
checks: Alert fires after the for duration

subtopics: Email, Slack and Microsoft Teams receivers
days.lab_task: Route critical alerts to an on-call channel and warnings to a team channel, group alerts by service, stop host alerts when the whole data centre is down and silence alerts during maintenance.
days.deliverable: Alertmanager configuration and notification screenshots
checks: Fire several alerts for one service

subtopics: Using recorded series in dashboards and alerts
days.lab_task: Find the slowest dashboard queries, replace them with recording rules, point the dashboard and alerts at the recorded series and compare load times.
days.deliverable: Recording rules and timing comparison

days.topic: Black-Box Monitoring with the Blackbox Exporter
subtopics: HTTP, TCP, ICMP and DNS probes
days.lab_task: Probe three websites over HTTP, a database port over TCP and DNS resolution, alert on failures and on certificates expiring within 14 days.
days.deliverable: Blackbox configuration, alerts and dashboard
checks: Probe fails and an alert fires

subtopics: Exporters for PostgreSQL, MySQL and Redis
Message queues: RabbitMQ and Kafka exporters
days.lab_task: Monitor PostgreSQL, Redis and Nginx with exporters, import and adjust community dashboards and add alerts for connection saturation and replication lag.
days.deliverable: Exporter configuration, dashboards and alerts
checks: Panels fixed for the local labels
Credentials read from files or environment

days.lab_task: Monitor containers with cAdvisor, find a container being CPU-throttled and one hitting its memory limit, and alert on restart loops.
days.deliverable: Configuration, dashboard and alerts

subtopics: Linking logs and metrics in dashboards
days.lab_task: Ship container and system logs to Loki, query errors with LogQL, turn error counts into a graph and link from a metrics panel to the matching logs.
days.deliverable: Agent configuration, LogQL queries and dashboard
checks: Error rate panel built from LogQL
Logs for the same service and time shown

days.topic: Provisioning Dashboards and Data Sources as Code
days.lab_task: Store data sources and dashboards in Git, provision them on start-up, rebuild Grafana from scratch and get the same dashboards back.
days.deliverable: Provisioning files and repository
checks: All dashboards and data sources back

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Monitoring a Web Application Stack
days.lab_task: Monitor a web app with a database and cache: exporters, instrumentation, blackbox probes, Loki logs, templated dashboards, alerts routed to chat and provisioning in Git, then handle three injected failures live.
days.deliverable: Repository, dashboards, alert rules and demo recording
checks: Alert received and cause visible on the dashboard
Each alert has a runbook note
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one stack
Monitor an application end to end

intermediate.summary: For engineers who run monitoring for teams. Covers advanced PromQL, kube-prometheus-stack, the Prometheus Operator, SLOs and burn-rate alerts, alert design and runbooks, Alertmanager high availability, Grafana alerting, long-term storage with Thanos and Mimir, cardinality, Prometheus performance, Tempo and OpenTelemetry, correlation, dashboards as code, Grafana access control, synthetic monitoring, custom exporters, cloud data sources, business dashboards and securing the stack.
prerequisites: Runs Prometheus and Grafana with exporters and alerts
Writes PromQL with rates and aggregation
outcomes: Monitor Kubernetes and applications with SLO-based alerting
Manage dashboards, access and monitoring security as code

days.topic: Advanced PromQL: Histograms, Joins and Prediction
days.lab_task: Calculate p95 and p99 latency per service from histograms, join metrics with info metrics to add team names, predict disk exhaustion and detect missing metrics.
days.deliverable: Query library with explanations

days.lab_task: Install kube-prometheus-stack with Helm, review default dashboards, find a pod with no resource limits and one in a crash loop, and tune two noisy default alerts.
days.deliverable: Helm values, findings and tuned alerts
checks: Fewer false alerts over a day

days.lab_task: Add a ServiceMonitor and PrometheusRule for an application in its own namespace, route its alerts with AlertmanagerConfig and fix a ServiceMonitor that selects nothing.
days.deliverable: Manifests and target and alert screenshots

days.topic: Service Level Objectives and Burn-Rate Alerts
subtopics: Sloth or Pyrra for generating rules
days.lab_task: Define availability and latency SLOs for an API, generate burn-rate rules, build an error budget dashboard and inject errors to see fast and slow burn alerts.
days.deliverable: SLO definitions, rules and dashboard
checks: Inject a slow trickle of errors

days.topic: Alert Design, Runbooks and On-Call Hygiene
days.lab_task: Review a month of alert history, delete or merge alerts that nobody acted on, write runbooks for the remaining pages and measure the drop in pages.
days.deliverable: Alert review, runbooks and before and after counts
checks: Alerts classified as useful or noise
Every paging alert has a runbook link
Fewer pages with no missed incidents

days.topic: Alertmanager High Availability and Advanced Routing
days.lab_task: Run three clustered Alertmanagers, route by team and severity with business-hours rules, send critical alerts to an on-call tool and test routes with amtool.
days.deliverable: Configuration, amtool tests and notification screenshots
checks: Each alert reaches the expected receiver
Fire a warning out of hours

subtopics: Alerting on logs and SQL data
days.lab_task: Create Grafana alerts on a Loki error query and a SQL business metric, route them with notification policies and write guidance on when to use Grafana or Prometheus alerting.
days.deliverable: Alert rules, policies and guidance
checks: Error-log alert delivered to the team contact point
Business metric alert delivered with the query value
Clear rules for each alerting system

days.topic: Long-Term Storage with Thanos and Grafana Mimir
days.lab_task: Keep a year of metrics by sending two Prometheus servers to Mimir with remote write, query both clusters from one Grafana data source and compare with a Thanos setup.
days.deliverable: Configuration, global queries and comparison
checks: Series from both clusters in one query
Trade-offs of Thanos and Mimir stated

subtopics: Working with teams on label design
days.lab_task: Find the five metrics with most series, drop an unbounded label with metric relabelling, set scrape limits and show memory use falling.
days.deliverable: Cardinality report, relabel rules and memory comparison

days.lab_task: Size Prometheus for 2 million series, shard scraping across two servers, run a remote site in agent mode and build a dashboard of Prometheus health.
days.deliverable: Sizing estimate, sharded configuration and health dashboard
checks: Each server scrapes half the targets
Ingestion, memory and rule timing shown

days.topic: Distributed Tracing with Tempo and OpenTelemetry
days.lab_task: Instrument two services with OpenTelemetry, send traces through a collector to Tempo, find a slow request with TraceQL and view the service graph.
days.deliverable: Instrumentation, collector configuration and trace screenshots

subtopics: Trace to logs and trace to metrics
days.lab_task: Add exemplars to latency histograms, put trace IDs in logs, link all three signals in Grafana and investigate a latency alert from metric to trace to log.
days.deliverable: Configuration and an investigation walkthrough
checks: Root cause found using all three signals

days.topic: Dashboards as Code with Grafonnet and Terraform
days.lab_task: Generate service dashboards for five services from one Jsonnet library, manage folders, data sources and permissions with Terraform and deploy them through CI.
days.deliverable: Jsonnet library, Terraform code and CI run
checks: Dashboard generated with no hand edits

days.topic: Grafana Users, Teams and Access Control
subtopics: Single sign-on with OAuth and SAML
days.lab_task: Connect Grafana to single sign-on, map groups to teams, give each team its own folder and data source access and create a service account for automation.
days.deliverable: SSO settings, team mappings and access tests
checks: Log in as a team member

subtopics: Synthetic checks compared with real users
days.lab_task: Script a login-and-checkout journey with k6, run it from two locations, alert when it fails and add its success rate to the SLO dashboard.
days.deliverable: k6 scripts, checks and dashboard
checks: Journey fails and an alert fires

subtopics: Error metrics for the exporter itself
days.lab_task: Write an exporter that reads queue sizes from an internal API, exposes them with good names and labels, reports its own scrape errors and runs as a container.
days.deliverable: Exporter code, image and tests

days.lab_task: Add CloudWatch and Azure Monitor data sources with least-privilege roles, build a dashboard combining managed database metrics with application metrics and alert on database CPU.
days.deliverable: Data source settings, dashboard and alert
checks: Cloud and Prometheus metrics on one dashboard

days.lab_task: Build a dashboard for an operations manager combining orders from SQL with checkout latency and errors from Prometheus, with business event annotations and a weekly report.
days.deliverable: Dashboard and report
checks: Effect of slow checkout on orders visible

subtopics: TLS and authentication for Prometheus and exporters
Sensitive data in metrics and logs
days.lab_task: Turn on TLS and basic authentication for Prometheus and exporters, move secrets out of configuration files, restrict exporter ports and remove personal data from logs.
days.deliverable: Secured configuration and test results

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: SLO-Driven Monitoring for a Kubernetes Platform
days.lab_task: Build monitoring for a Kubernetes platform with three services: operator-managed scraping, SLOs with burn-rate alerts, long-term storage, logs and traces linked, dashboards as code and SSO, then investigate an injected incident from alert to root cause.
days.deliverable: Repository, dashboards, SLO definitions and incident walkthrough
checks: Burn-rate alert fires and the cause is found through traces
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For SREs, platform engineers and observability leads. Covers observability architecture, multi-tenant Mimir, Loki and Tempo at scale, highly available Prometheus, the OpenTelemetry Collector, continuous profiling, eBPF instrumentation, SLO programmes, capacity planning, anomaly detection, incident response, observability cost, Grafana plugins, observability as a platform, migrations, metric governance, compliance, testing observability and troubleshooting the stack.
prerequisites: Runs Prometheus, Grafana, Loki and Tempo for several teams
Writes advanced PromQL and SLO rules
Manages Kubernetes and infrastructure as code
outcomes: Design and run multi-tenant observability at scale
Add profiling and eBPF signals and run SLO programmes
Control observability cost and govern metrics

subtopics: Requirements: scale, tenants, retention and cost
Data flows for metrics, logs, traces and profiles
tools: Grafana Cloud or self-hosted LGTM stack
days.lab_task: Design observability for a company with 200 services in three regions, choose self-hosted or cloud with costs, document data flows and failure modes and defend the design.
days.deliverable: Architecture design, decision records and review notes

days.topic: Running Multi-Tenant Mimir, Loki and Tempo at Scale
days.lab_task: Deploy Mimir, Loki and Tempo in microservices mode with three tenants, set per-tenant limits, load test ingestion and run a rolling upgrade with no data loss.
days.deliverable: Helm values, limits, load test results and upgrade log
checks: That tenant throttled and others unaffected
objectives: Run the LGTM stack at scale

days.topic: Highly Available Prometheus and Remote Write at Scale
days.lab_task: Run HA Prometheus pairs with deduplication in Mimir, tune remote write for a 500,000 samples per second load, partition the network and confirm data completeness afterwards.
days.deliverable: Configuration, tuning results and completeness test
checks: Lag stays low at the target load

days.lab_task: Build an agent and gateway collector pipeline that redacts personal data, tail-samples traces keeping all errors, routes data by tenant and scales under load.
days.deliverable: Collector configuration and test results
checks: Send a trace with an error

days.lab_task: Profile three services continuously, compare flame graphs before and after a release, link a slow trace to its profile and fix the hot spot.
days.deliverable: Profiling setup, comparison and fix
checks: New hot spot found in the diff view
Link a trace to a profile
Profile for the slow span shown
CPU use lower after the fix

subtopics: HTTP and gRPC metrics from eBPF
days.lab_task: Add RED metrics and traces to an uninstrumented legacy service with Beyla, compare with SDK instrumentation on another service and list what eBPF could not capture.
days.deliverable: Beyla configuration, comparison and limits list
checks: RED metrics present without code changes

days.topic: Running an SLO Programme Across Teams
days.lab_task: Set up SLOs for ten services with owners, write an error budget policy, run a role-play SLO review where a team has spent its budget and produce a leadership report.
days.deliverable: SLO catalogue, policy, review notes and report
checks: Every service has an owner and SLO
Agreed action for the spent budget
SLO status by service and trend

subtopics: Forecasting with predict_linear and external tools
days.lab_task: Forecast CPU, memory and storage for a cluster for six months including seasonal peaks, set headroom targets and present scaling dates and costs.
days.deliverable: Forecasts, capacity dashboard and plan
checks: Dates and costs for each resource

days.topic: Anomaly Detection and Forecasting in Grafana
days.lab_task: Build anomaly alerts for order volume with seasonal baselines, detect an outlier instance in a group, compare with static thresholds over a month of data and count false alerts.
days.deliverable: Baseline rules, outlier detection and comparison
checks: Counts for both methods over the month

days.lab_task: Set up on-call schedules and escalations, run a simulated incident through declaration, roles, timeline and status updates, and write the post-incident review with actions.
days.deliverable: On-call configuration, incident record and review
checks: On-call engineer paged and escalated when unacknowledged

tools: Grafana Cloud usage data or Mimir and Loki metrics
days.lab_task: Measure observability usage by team, cut metric series with aggregation, cut log volume by dropping debug logs at the agent, tune sampling and report monthly savings.
days.deliverable: Usage report, changes and savings report
checks: Series, log volume and traces per team
Volume lower with dashboards still working

subtopics: Plugin types: panels, data sources and apps
React and TypeScript in panel plugins
Backend data source plugins in Go
days.lab_task: Build a data source plugin for an internal API and a simple panel plugin, test them, sign them for private use and install them in Grafana.
days.deliverable: Plugin code, tests and installed plugins

subtopics: Default dashboards and alerts for every service
days.lab_task: Build self-service onboarding that gives a new service scraping, logs, traces, default dashboards and SLO alerts from one manifest, onboard two services and survey their teams.
days.deliverable: Onboarding templates, onboarded services and survey results

days.topic: Migrating from Nagios, Zabbix or Datadog
subtopics: Mapping checks to metrics and alerts
Running old and new in parallel
days.lab_task: Map 50 Nagios checks and five Datadog dashboards to Prometheus alerts and Grafana dashboards, run both systems in parallel for a week and plan the cutover.
days.deliverable: Mapping table, converted alerts and dashboards and cutover plan

days.lab_task: Write label standards, add a CI linter that rejects bad metric names and unbounded labels, find unused metrics from query logs and retire them.
days.deliverable: Standards, linter and retirement report
checks: Metrics with no queries in 30 days listed

days.topic: Compliance, Retention and Sensitive Data in Observability
subtopics: Personal data in logs and traces
Redaction at the source and in pipelines
days.lab_task: Find personal data in logs and traces, redact it in the pipeline, set retention by data type, keep EU data in the EU region and prepare audit evidence.
days.deliverable: Findings, redaction rules, retention settings and evidence pack
checks: Search for personal data after redaction
EU tenant data stored only in the EU

days.lab_task: Inject five failures into a Kubernetes app, record whether and how fast each was detected, fix the monitoring gaps found and re-run the experiments.
days.deliverable: Experiment plan, detection results and fixes

days.topic: Observability for AI and LLM Applications
subtopics: What to measure in LLM applications
Token use, latency and cost metrics
Tracing prompts, retrieval and tool calls
OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI
Quality signals: feedback and evaluation scores
Protecting prompts and responses in telemetry
Dashboards and alerts for AI services
days.lab_task: Instrument a retrieval-augmented chat service with traces for retrieval and model calls, metrics for tokens, cost and latency, GPU metrics from the DCGM exporter and alerts on cost and error spikes, with prompts redacted.
days.deliverable: Instrumentation, dashboard and alert rules
checks: Retrieval and model spans in one trace

subtopics: Symptoms of a broken monitoring stack
Meta-monitoring and dead man's switch alerts
days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected stack failures (a scrape timeout, out-of-order samples, a throttled tenant, a slow query and broken alert delivery) and add a dead man's switch alert.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and meta-monitoring alerts
checks: Dead man's switch alert reaches the backup channel

days.lab_task: Design and build an observability platform for a case company: multi-tenant LGTM and profiling, collector pipelines with redaction, self-service onboarding, an SLO programme, cost controls and incident response, then run a game day and present to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, platform code, game day report and board presentation
checks: Injected failures detected and handled through on-call
Cost per team within the budget
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
